ios.desc:
Transform your writing process with Vibrant Frog Collab - the AI-powered collaborative writing app designed for authors, poets, and creative writers.

NEW: Library Chat Tools
Your AI writing assistant now has tools built for the full book workflow. Queue passages directly to your book, export project conversations, access document versions, and manage your scratchpad — all from a single chat interface. The AI can read your documents and act on them without you leaving the conversation.

Lyric Video Creator
Turn your poems into captivating videos! Record your voice reading aloud, then create lyric videos with animated text that syncs to your audio. Choose from three stunning modes:

Video Background - Use your own videos as backdrops
Photo Slideshow - Cycle through photos that match your words
Static Image - A single beautiful background
Customize text appearance, add a final frame with the complete poem, and include your original transcription image. Export videos ready to share on social media.

Scan Handwritten Text
Photograph your handwritten manuscripts, notes, and drafts. Our AI instantly transcribes them into digital text while preserving your structure, paragraphs, and voice. Perfect for writers who think best with pen and paper.

Collaborate with AI
Work alongside powerful AI models to refine your writing. Get help with structure, flow, grammar, and style while maintaining your unique creative voice. The AI reads and edits your document directly - no copy-pasting required.

Book Export
Compile multiple works into a beautifully formatted PDF book with table of contents and automatic page breaks.

Quote Image Creator
Turn your poems and phrases into beautiful images. Overlay text on photos with customizable positioning, fonts, and frosted glass backgrounds.

AI Photo Search (Power Users)
Connect your photo library with VibrantFrog indexing to search photos by description. Ask the AI to "find sunset photos" and it understands visual content.

Your Keys, Your Privacy
Connect using your own API keys from Anthropic or OpenAI. All documents stay on your device. We never see your content or credentials.

Features:

Library Chat with book-queue and document tools
Lyric video export with three background modes
Audio recording for voice readings
Handwritten text scanning and transcription
AI providers: Anthropic and OpenAI
Book export with table of contents
Quote image creator with text positioning
Project-based document organization
Export to PDF, video, ima

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an iOS app for writers who still use pen and paper

quotes.text:
I'm a software architect working on AI tooling and MCP. Last August I started writing again—by hand, every morning at 7am—after a 30-year detour from literature into engineering.

The workflow to transform handwritten pages into something shareable was painful: photograph, transcribe, edit, pair with an image, format. Each step a context switch.

So I built Vibrant Frog Collab to do it my way.

Core philosophy: AI enhances, doesn't replace. The app has guardrails baked in that can't be overridden—it won't generate content from scratch, only help develop what you've already written.

Features:
- Handwriting scan → instant transcription
- AI collaborative editing with memory across conversations
- Quote image creation (text on photos)
- BYOK: Claude, GPT-4 with your own API keys or Gemini with Google OAuth
- $9.99 one-time, no subscription, free version available

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vibrant-frog-collab/id6756248063

Happy to answer questions about the technical side, the philosophy, or the writing practice.
